title: No Convergence in Learned Eavesdropping-Detection Dynamics for BB84 Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.16372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In prior work we showed that a reinforcement-learning eavesdropper can intercept BB84 quantum key distribution while holding the quantum bit error rate below the abort threshold and keeping a usable distillable key. In this paper we ask whether an equally adaptive learning detector can close this stealth window. We cast the interaction as an alternating best-response game between a tabular eavesdropper and a tabular threshold-adapting detector. We measure exploitability, which is the detection rate and distillable key fraction achieved by a fresh attacker best-responding to the final detector. Across three learning rules (Q-Learning, SARSA, Double Q-Learning), three channel-noise levels, and a uniform false-alarm discipline, the dynamics do not settle out to twenty rounds. translated_title: BB84量子密钥分发中学习型窃听-检测动力学的不收敛性
translated_abstract: 在先前的工作中，我们证明了强化学习窃听者可以在拦截BB84量子密钥分发的同时，将量子比特误码率维持在系统中止阈值以下，并保留可用的可蒸馏密钥。本文探讨一个同样具有自适应能力的学习型检测器能否关闭这一隐蔽攻击窗口。我们将双方的交互建模为表格型窃听者与表格型阈值自适应检测器之间的交替最优响应博弈，并测量“可利用性”，即一个新的攻击者对最终检测器做出最优响应时所达到的检测率与可蒸馏密钥比例。在三种学习规则、三种信道噪声水平以及统一误报约束下，双方动力学在二十轮内均不收敛：可利用性不逼近不动点，其逐轮波动也不衰减。两个对照实验中，其一针对冻结的防御者重新训练攻击者……
tldr: 该论文将强化学习窃听者与自适应学习型检测器在BB84量子密钥分发中的对抗建模为交替最优响应博弈，并发现无论采用何种学习规则、噪声水平或误报约束，双方动力学均不收敛，可利用性不趋于不动点，表明学习型检测器无法稳定关闭窃听的隐蔽窗口。
en_tdlr: By modeling the adversarial interplay between a reinforcement-learning eavesdropper and an adaptive learning detector in BB84 QKD as an alternating best-response game, this paper shows that across multiple learning rules, noise levels, and a uniform false-alarm discipline, the dynamics fail to converge within twenty rounds, with exploitability never approaching a fixed point, indicating that learned detection cannot stably close the eavesdropping stealth window.
